best_for: Windows users who want a light, free video and music player in the classic Media Player Classic style, including on older PCs back to Windows 7.

points.title: Classic player, still developed
points.text: MPC-BE is a free GPL-3.0 player that grew out of the original Media Player Classic and MPC-HC code, with extra features and fixes on top.

points.title: Plays most files out of the box
points.text: It plays common video and audio files, supports hardware decoding and deinterlacing, and mounts ISO images on its own.

points.title: Runs on old hardware
points.text: It supports Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10 and 11 in 32-bit and 64-bit. The CPU needs SSE2 and the graphics card DirectX 9.0c with Shader Model 3.0.

points.title: Windows only
points.text: There is no Mac or Linux version. On those systems look at a different player.

points.title: Zip packages here
points.text: The builds listed here are zip archives for x86 and x64, and the listing keeps 26 versions. Nightly builds are linked from the project's GitHub wiki for those who want fixes early.
